claim: Castillo de San Marcos is a 13th-century fortress now owned by Bodegas Caballero; visits combine castle history with a Jerez wine tasting, open 10:00-16:00 Sept-June (10:00-20:00 July-Aug), with guided tours Tue-Fri at 13:00 and Sat at 11:00 and 13:00, costing roughly 8-14 for castle visits and 14-20 for the castle-plus-winery tasting.
quote: Castle + winery with wine tasting | 2 hours | 14-20 | ... discover a wonderful historic winery ... three excellent Jerez wines, a Lustau vermouth and the famous Ponche Caballero. Tuesday-Friday: 1:00 PM tour; Saturdays: 11:00 AM and 1:00 PM tours

claim: The Castillo de San Marcos was built over a former mosque by King Alfonso X the Wise after the Reconquest, layering Moorish and Christian heritage in the heart of the old town.
quote: a 13th-century fortress built over a former mosque by King Alfonso X the Wise following the taking of the town during the Reconquest

claim: El Puerto's Plaza Real de Toros, one of Spain's largest and most prestigious bullrings, can be visited Tue-Fri 10:00-14:00 and 17:00-19:00 and Sat 10:00-14:00, with guided visits 6 and self-guided 4.
quote: open Tuesday to Friday from 10:00 to 14:00 and 17:00 to 19:00, and Saturday from 10:00 to 14:00 ... Guided visits cost 6, and self-guided visits cost 4 ... managed by the company Serlo S.L.

claim: Visitors warn the Plaza de Toros has sometimes been found closed during its posted opening hours despite advance confirmation, so calling ahead is advisable.
quote: the bullring has been closed during posted opening hours despite advance confirmation with the tourist office, so it's advisable to confirm hours before your visit

claim: The Fundación Rafael Alberti, the poet's childhood home on Calle Santo Domingo 25, opens Tue-Fri 10:00-14:00 and Sat-Sun 11:00-14:00; general admission is 4 (2 students/pensioners, free for El Puerto residents).
quote: abierto de martes a viernes de 10:00 a 14:00 horas, y los sabados y domingos de 11:00 a 14:00 horas ... La entrada general cuesta 4, estudiantes y pensionistas 2 ... gratuito para nacidos o residentes en El Puerto de Santa Maria

claim: The Iglesia Mayor Prioral, a minor basilica documented from 1486 and promoted by the Dukes of Medinaceli, dominates the old-town square as the city's principal church.
quote: Its construction is documented from 1486, coinciding with the construction boom promoted by the Dukes of Medinaceli, who were the jurisdictional lords of the town

claim: The Iglesia Mayor Prioral is under restoration into early 2026 with scaffolding on the facade, but access through the Puerta del Sol stays open and worship continues uninterrupted.
quote: despite the scaffolding covering the facade, access to the temple through the Puerta del Sol will remain open at all times, and religious worship and liturgical activities will not be interrupted

claim: The Monasterio de la Victoria, a former Minim monastery now declared Bien de Interes Cultural and used for concerts and exhibitions, can be visited Mondays and Fridays (except holidays) 11:00-14:00, with a tour of the church, cloister and chapter halls plus an 11-minute introductory video.
quote: abierto todos los lunes y viernes (excepto festivos) entre las 11:00 y las 14:00 horas ... podra contemplar la iglesia, el claustro y las salas capitulares ... un video introductorio de alrededor de 11 minutos

claim: The Museo Municipal at Calle Pagador 1 has free admission and opens Tue-Fri 10:00-14:00 and Sat/Sun/holidays 11:00-14:00, housing the city's archaeological and fine-arts collections.
quote: Tuesday to Friday: 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.; Saturday, Sunday and holidays: 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. ... Admission is free ... C/ Pagador, n 1

claim: El Puerto's nickname 'City of the Hundred Palaces' comes from the 17th-18th-century casas-palacio of the cargadores a Indias, three-storey merchant mansions built around porticoed patios and crowned with mirador watchtowers; landmark examples are the 1660 Palacio de Aranibar (the oldest) and the Casa-Palacio de Vizarron (de las Cadenas), which hosted Felipe V and Isabel de Farnesio in 1729-1730.
quote: the city of the Cien Palacios (Hundred Palaces) ... structured in three floors ... watchtower or mirador tower ... Palacio de Aranibar, built in 1660, considered the oldest house of cargadores a Indias ... Casa-Palacio de Vizarron or of the Chains, which in 1729 and 1730 hosted the Spanish kings Felipe V and Isabel de Farnesio

claim: In April 2026 the Guadalete riverfront gained a new draw with the opening of La Ribera, a gastronomic market on Avenida de la Bajamar at the catamaran terminal combining food stalls, terraces and leisure programming.
quote: the Guadalete riverfront area gained a new focus of activity with the opening of La Ribera, a gastronomic market located on Avenida de la Bajamar at the catamaran terminal

claim: El Puerto is transforming its Guadalete riverfront into a paseo fluvial of six promenades and plazas with green areas and event spaces, and a second pedestrian footbridge over the river was due for completion in early 2026.
quote: six promenades and plazas ... public spaces for events and cultural activities, along with new green areas and recreational zones ... A second pedestrian footbridge over the Guadalete River is expected to be completed by February or March 2026
